          CURSOR

Cursor — AI coding agent

Cross-platform CLI agent that works with codebases, files, commands, and repositories. Keyboard-native. Zero-config startup. No bloat.

Download GitHub

Install

# npm
npm i -g @bniladridas/cursor

# brew
brew tap palmshed/cursor && brew install palmshed/cursor/cursor

# curl (Linux/macOS)
curl -fsSL https://github.com/bniladridas/cursor/raw/main/install.sh | sudo sh

# from source
cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build

What it does

Chat

Ask questions about your codebase. AI answers with context-aware responses and markdown rendering.

Commands

Search web, run git, read files, execute shell commands — all from the prompt.

Agentic

Set goals, track tasks, and let Cursor work through complex workflows autonomously.

Multi-service

Ollama, OpenAI-compatible APIs, GitHub, MCP servers — plug in what you need.

Quick start

cursor
# picks mode (Online/Offline) and model, drops you in
> what does this project do?
│ Cursor
│ Cursor is an AI coding agent for the terminal...

Platforms

Pre-built binaries for Linux (amd64), macOS (arm64), and Windows (amd64) — on the releases page.

Design

Input-first, progressive disclosure, zero-config startup. Every pixel serves one goal: reduce friction between thought and action. Read the full design spec.
